note: Illustrative ranges compiled from 2026 third-party data (AIR Media-Tech, vidIQ, creatorblade, shorts/saturaai, flowshorts, projectcasting, creatorsjet, elev8or). Platform rates change constantly — verify live before making decisions. These are ranges, not promises.

facebook_content_monetization.fast_track_mar2026: $1,000/mo at 100K+ followers or $3,000/mo at 1M+ followers (IG/TikTok/YT count), US/Canada, 3-month cap, 15 original Reels/month across 10+ days (TechCrunch/PetaPixel Mar 2026)
facebook_content_monetization.note_2025: Meta paid ~$3B to creators in 2025 (+35% YoY, ~60% on Reels); Reels generated ~60% of payouts (socialbee Sep 2026)
facebook_content_monetization.rpm_note: Wide range; Reels often $0.02–$0.20. Instagram has NO standing Reels bonus (Reels Play ended 2023) — IG stack is brand deals, affiliates, subscriptions, invite-only bonuses (timetopost.co)
facebook_content_monetization.source: shortsync, socialbee, techcrunch, petapixel, timetopost.co, Oct 2026

tiktok_creator_rewards.eligibility: 10K followers + 100K video views in last 30 days + 18+ + personal account in good standing (kompozy Jul 2026, multilogin Sep 2026)
tiktok_creator_rewards.eligible_countries_note: Availability figures vary across sources (8–50+) — verify against creators.tiktok.com
tiktok_creator_rewards.rpm_note: Only videos over 1 minute with original content qualify; earning starts after 1,000 qualified For You views; paid monthly on the 15th at $50 balance. Payout = qualified views/1,000 x RPM + Additional Reward quality bonus
tiktok_creator_rewards.source: creatorblade.com Oct 11 2026, AIR Media-Tech Oct 10 2026, kompozy, multilogin

youtube_ypp_tier2_full.note_2027: CONFIRMED via fresh check Oct 11, 2026: YouTube announced Aug 10, 2026 — new applicants from Feb 1, 2027 need 1,000 subs + 8,000 qualified watch hours over 365 days OR 20M qualified Shorts views over 90 days (up from 4,000 hrs / 10M views). 1,000-sub floor unchanged; existing partners grandfathered; fan-funding tier unchanged. Multiple press: Cartoon Brew, Tech Times, Hypebeast, AIR Media-Tech, Music Business Worldwide.
youtube_ypp_tier2_full.source: YouTube Help Center via 1of10/air.io, Oct 2026; 2027 change confirmed via press Aug 2026
youtube_ypp_tier2_full.watch_time_gate_note: Thresholds are entry fees, not guarantees — watch-time is the real gate, and YouTube's Jan 2026 enforcement wave reportedly stripped tens of millions of subscribers from mass-produced/AI-content channels (medium.com Sep 2026, single source — flag)

sponsorship_rate_card_2026.disclaimer: Negotiation ranges, not quotes. Compiled 2026 agency benchmarks (air.io, projectcasting, creatorsjet, talentir) — benchmarks disagree 2-3x within tiers. Niche, engagement, format, and usage rights move numbers as much as follower count. Creators list rates ~23% above what they accept; 41% offer package discounts on 3+ posts.

sponsorship_rule_of_thumb.integrated_vs_ad_rpm: An integrated YouTube sponsor slot pays $20–$35 per 1,000 views vs ~$2.30 median ad RPM (9–15x) — sponsorships dwarf platform payouts (air.io, Oct 10 2026)
sponsorship_rule_of_thumb.negotiation_note: Listed rates run ~23% above accepted rates — negotiate. Usage rights are the most-neglected line item: price paid-ad usage of your content SEPARATELY from the post fee (projectcasting.com, Sep 2026)
sponsorship_rule_of_thumb.note: Common starting point: $20–$50 per 1,000 expected views for a dedicated integration in mid-value niches; finance/tech 2–3x, entertainment lower. Negotiate on audience quality, not just views. Verify with current creator rate reports.

youtube_longform_rpm_source_note: Research pass Oct 11, 2026 (AIR Media-Tech / ytmoneycalculator / saturaai): low CPM niches (gaming, entertainment) $1.50–$4; mid (education, lifestyle) $4–$10; high (finance, business) $8–$20; music $0.75–$1.65. Monetized playbacks typically 60–85% of views. Q4 pays 40–80% more than Q1.
